name: Glasses, raw from the SD card (livedata.json.gz)
description: One simulated Glasses 2 recording at 100 samples per second in the raw format the recording unit writes to its SD card: one JSON packet per line for gaze position, gaze direction, pupil diameter, gyroscope and accelerometer, plus two marked tasks. Gaze is in scene-video coordinates, which move with the head; there is no stimulus image.
